privacy.seeAlso: See also: Terms of Service and Safety

terms.title: Know your rights and responsibilities
terms.eligibilityDesc: You must be 18+ and legally able to enter into agreements. Accounts may be suspended for fraud, harassment, or policy violations.
useItems: No harassment, hate speech, or abusive behavior.
No impersonation or sharing of others' private information.
Keep communications on-platform; off-platform sharing is at your own risk.
paymentsItems: In-person verification: PKR 20,000 when both parties agree; 20% platform fee, PKR 16,000 to bureau.
Application and registration fees for bureaus are non-refundable.
terms.verificationDesc: You agree to provide accurate information. Verification photos/IDs are used for safety checks. In-person verification is optional but adds trust.
conductItems: No explicit content, scams, or solicitation.
We may moderate, suspend, or remove content that violates these terms.
terms.liabilityDesc: Service is provided 'as is'. We are not liable for offline meetings or outcomes. Use personal judgment and safety guidelines.
terms.seeAlso: See also: Privacy Policy and Safety

returnRefund.title: Refunds and cancellations
returnRefund.overviewDesc: International Rishta provides digital subscription services. Refund eligibility depends on the plan type and the timing of your request.
eligibilityItems: Failed payment where access was not granted.
Subscription cancellations within 24 hours of the first charge (first-time subscribers only).
processItems: Email billing@internationalrishta.com with your account email and payment receipt.
Include the reason for the request and the date of the charge.
We review requests within 5 business days and notify you of the outcome.
exceptionsItems: In-person verification fees once the service is delivered.

shippingService.title: Service delivery
shippingService.deliveryDesc: All services are delivered digitally through your International Rishta account after payment confirmation.
timelineItems: Subscription access: immediately after successful payment.
Profile verification review: typically within 24-48 hours.
Bureau verification scheduling: coordinated after both parties agree.
issuesItems: Confirm your payment status in the app or receipt email.
Check for verification requests or missing information.
Contact support for manual review or assistance.
shippingService.locationDesc: We primarily serve users in Pakistan. International access may be limited while cross-border messaging is in beta.
shippingService.contact: Need help with service delivery? Contact <email>support@internationalrishta.com</email>

safety.subtitle: Our top guidelines to keep you protected on and off the platform.
onPlatformItems: Verify your profile; keep your info accurate.
Use in-app messaging and video before meeting.
